write_up: A recruiter sees a healthcare operations executive who has grown a dental organization while improving margins, integration time, and clinician retention. The current role puts the size of the business and your responsibility for it up front.
The integration playbook line is a good model: it names what you changed and how much faster the work became. Earlier roles are just as easy to follow, particularly the surgery center turnaround.
